title: Swimming Before Work
sentences: I started swimming before work about eight months ago.
The pool opens at half past six, and I am usually the third to arrive.
At the beginning I could only manage ten lengths without stopping.
I had told myself I would go twice a week and no more.
By the second month I was going four mornings out of five.
The water is cold enough to wake me up completely.
I arrive at the office feeling calmer than I used to.
My shoulders ached badly for the first few weeks.
That has passed, although my hair is permanently damp.
I doubt I will ever be fast, but I no longer need to be.
